result.summary: Identified 3 minor to major visual and content issues regarding placeholder assets, text clipping, and test data.

issues.description: Simplified vector illustrations are used as placeholders instead of real food photography.
issues.suggestion: Replace flat graphics with authentic high-resolution restaurant photos.

issues.description: The title 'Trattoria Piccol' is abruptly truncated in the horizontal list.
issues.suggestion: Enable text wrapping to two lines or apply standard ellipsis formatting.

issues.description: The badge displaying '-100%' appears to be placeholder data.
